description:
An unmodified build of io.prometheus.jmx:jmx_prometheus_javaagent, re-published under the
        pl.touk.prometheus.jmx groupId so that it can be consumed as a normal Maven
        dependency.
        Published because Prometheus publishes this artifact to GitHub releases only.
        See https://github.com/prometheus/jmx_exporter/blob/main/README.md
